data.name: Ifraaza
data.gender_notes: Ifraaza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'ifra' which means to be exalted, raised, elevated, or to become free from something. In Islamic context, it is used to describe the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) being taken up to the heavens after his death. It also symbolizes spiritual growth and elevation in one's faith. The name Ifraaza carries the meaning “Exalted, Raised, Elevated” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ifraaza usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, raised, elevated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a spiritual meaning, inspiring growth and elevation in one's faith.
data.etymology: Ifraaza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Raised, Elevated.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ifraaza total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
